# Cell Cycle

Phase distribution per sample, and comparison of regression strategies.

```{r setup}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)
library(patchwork)
library(targets)

source(file.path("src/R/scrna-seq_utilities.R"))
```

```{r load}
targets::tar_load(proc_params)
targets::tar_load(excluded_genes)

SUBSET_NAMES  <- c("stroma", "hsc", "mnc")
CC_STRATEGIES <- c("none", "full", "diff")
REF_ASSAY     <- proc_params$ref_assay
PCA_NAME      <- paste0("pca.", REF_ASSAY)
N_DIMS        <- proc_params$n_pca_dims
K             <- proc_params$k_neighbors
K_UMAP        <- proc_params$n_umap_neighbors
RES_TARGET    <- proc_params$marker_resolution
PHASE_COLS    <- c("G1" = "#4daf4a", "S" = "#225ea8", "G2M" = "#e41a1c")
RES_PAT       <- paste0("_res\\.", gsub("\\.", "\\\\.", RES_TARGET), "$")
```

```{r helpers}
# Run one CC strategy on a clean Seurat object.
# Returns a minimal list with only what is needed for plotting:
#   - metadata: Phase, sample.name, cluster column
#   - umap embeddings
run_strategy <- function(srt, strategy) {
  if (strategy == "diff")
    srt[["CC.Difference"]] <- srt$S.Score - srt$G2M.Score

  vars_reg <- switch(strategy,
    "none" = NULL,
    "full" = c("S.Score", "G2M.Score"),
    "diff" = "CC.Difference"
  )

  suppressMessages(invisible(
    srt <- preprocess_seurat(srt,
                              ref_assay       = REF_ASSAY,
                              n_features      = proc_params$n_features,
                              exclude_genes   = excluded_genes,
                              vars_to_regress = vars_reg)
  ))

  suppressMessages(invisible(
    srt <- find_neighbors_clusters(srt,
                                    dims_i    = seq(N_DIMS),
                                    ref_assay = REF_ASSAY,
                                    k         = K,
                                    res       = RES_TARGET)
  ))

  nn_name <- paste0("neighbors_", PCA_NAME, "_", K)
  suppressMessages(invisible(
    srt <- Seurat::RunUMAP(srt,
                            nn.name        = nn_name,
                            n.neighbors    = K_UMAP,
                            reduction.name = "umap.nn",
                            return.model   = FALSE,
                            verbose        = FALSE)
  ))

  clust_col <- grep(RES_PAT, colnames(srt@meta.data), value = TRUE)[1]
  umap_emb  <- as.data.frame(Seurat::Embeddings(srt, "umap.nn"))
  colnames(umap_emb) <- c("UMAP_1", "UMAP_2")

  result <- list(
    meta = srt@meta.data[, c("sample.name", "Phase", clust_col)],
    umap = umap_emb,
    clust_col = clust_col
  )
  rm(srt); gc()
  result
}
```

```{r run-all, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results='hide'}
# Process one subset at a time: load → run 3 strategies → extract → discard.
# Only lightweight metadata + UMAP coordinates are kept in all_results.
all_results   <- list()
phase_meta_list <- list()   # for section 1 (phase bar, needs only raw meta)

for (subset_name in SUBSET_NAMES) {
  message("=== ", subset_name, " ===")

  tar_target_name <- paste0("mpn_clean_", subset_name)
  targets::tar_load(tar_target_name)
  srt_clean <- get(tar_target_name)

  # Section 1 data: raw metadata before any processing
  phase_meta_list[[subset_name]] <- srt_clean@meta.data[, c("sample.name", "Phase")]

  # Run all strategies, keeping only extracted results
  all_results[[subset_name]] <- lapply(
    setNames(CC_STRATEGIES, CC_STRATEGIES),
    function(strat) {
      message("  strategy: ", strat)
      run_strategy(srt_clean, strat)
    }
  )

  rm(srt_clean, list = tar_target_name)
  gc()
}
```

## 1. Phase distribution per sample

`Phase` was scored inside `add_qc_flags()` on the full merged object, so it is
already present on each clean subset.

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r phase-bar, results='asis', echo=FALSE, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
for (subset_name in SUBSET_NAMES) {
  cat("###", subset_name, "\n\n")

  p <- phase_meta_list[[subset_name]] |>
    count(sample.name, Phase) |>
    group_by(sample.name) |>
    mutate(pct = 100 * n / sum(n)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    ggplot(aes(x = sample.name, y = pct, fill = Phase)) +
    geom_col(alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = PHASE_COLS) +
    labs(title = paste0("Cell-cycle phase distribution — ", subset_name),
         x = NULL, y = "% cells") +
    theme_bw() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
  print(p)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

:::

## 2. Phase on UMAP (pipeline run)

UMAP from the pipeline (`processed_<subset>`) can be loaded here if available,
but the regression comparison below runs its own UMAP for fair comparison.
Skip this section if the pipeline hasn't been run yet.

```{r phase-umap}
#| eval: TRUE
# Load pipeline-processed objects for a given subset (edit subset_name as needed)
subset_name <- "stroma"   # "stroma" | "hsc" | "mnc"
umap_name <- "umap.nn"
targets::tar_load(paste0("mpn_processed_", subset_name))
srt_proc <- get(paste0("mpn_processed_", subset_name))

p_phase_raw <- Seurat::DimPlot(
  srt_proc, group.by = "Phase",
  cols      = PHASE_COLS,
  reduction = umap_name, pt.size = 0.3
)
lean_dimplot(p_phase_raw, colour_col = "Phase",
             cols = PHASE_COLS,
             legend_title = "Phase")
```

## 3. Regression comparison

Compare three strategies for handling the cell-cycle signal.
Each strategy runs `preprocess_seurat()` with different regression choices,
then clusters and plots.

Strategies:

- `"none"`: no regression (pipeline default)
- `"full"`: regress out `S.Score` and `G2M.Score`
- `"diff"`: regress out the difference score only (`S.Score - G2M.Score`)

### Phase on UMAP

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r cc-umap-panel, results='asis', echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
for (subset_name in SUBSET_NAMES) {
  cat("###", subset_name, "\n\n")

  plots <- list()
  for (strat in CC_STRATEGIES) {
    res        <- all_results[[subset_name]][[strat]]
    df         <- cbind(res$umap, Phase = res$meta$Phase)
    plots[[strat]] <- ggplot(df, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, colour = Phase)) +
      geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.6) +
      scale_colour_manual(values = PHASE_COLS) +
      labs(title = paste0("Phase (CC regression: ", strat, ")")) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(legend.position = "bottom")
  }
  print(wrap_plots(plots, ncol = length(CC_STRATEGIES)))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

:::

### Clusters on UMAP

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r cc-cluster-panel, results='asis', echo=FALSE, fig.width=12, fig.height=4}
for (subset_name in SUBSET_NAMES) {
  cat("###", subset_name, "\n\n")

  plots <- list()
  for (strat in CC_STRATEGIES) {
    res      <- all_results[[subset_name]][[strat]]
    clust    <- res$meta[[res$clust_col]]
    n_cl     <- nlevels(factor(clust))
    df       <- cbind(res$umap, cluster = clust)
    plots[[strat]] <- ggplot(df, aes(x = UMAP_1, y = UMAP_2, colour = cluster)) +
      geom_point(size = 0.3, alpha = 0.6) +
      labs(title = paste0(strat, "  (", n_cl, " clusters)")) +
      theme_bw() +
      theme(legend.position = "none")
  }
  print(wrap_plots(plots, ncol = length(CC_STRATEGIES)))
  cat("\n\n")
}
```

:::

## 4. Phase composition per cluster

Compare how phase mix differs across clusters in the no-regression run.

::: {.panel-tabset}

```{r phase-per-cluster, results='asis', echo=FALSE, fig.width=7, fig.height=4}
for (subset_name in SUBSET_NAMES) {
  cat("###", subset_name, "\n\n")
  res       <- all_results[[subset_name]][["none"]]
  clust_col <- res$clust_col

  p <- res$meta |>
    count(.data[[clust_col]], Phase) |>
    rename(cluster = 1) |>
    group_by(cluster) |>
    mutate(pct = round(100 * n / sum(n), 1)) |>
    ungroup() |>
    ggplot(aes(x = cluster, y = pct, fill = Phase)) +
    geom_col(alpha = 0.85) +
    scale_fill_manual(values = PHASE_COLS) +
    labs(title = paste0("Phase composition per cluster — ", subset_name,
                        paste0(" (no CC regression, res ", RES_TARGET, ")")),
         x = "Cluster", y = "% cells") +
    theme_bw()
  print(p)
  cat("\n\n")
}
```
